autonomous_and_hitl_operational_pipeline.title: TinyFish Web-Agent Outward Public Surface Walk & Permissionless Claim Capture
steps: 1. Walk public human doors (/my-results, /benchmarks, /verify, /arena, /city, /academy, HF Space csoai/gspc-board) and verify HTTP 200 + working DOM actions.
2. Poll public SEC EDGAR S-1/10-K/8-K filings and vendor release pages into permissionless claim records (s1-ipo-measurement-readiness-v1.json).
3. Register captured claims in /api/claims/register with Day-7, Day-30, and Day-90 re-check schedules.
autonomous_and_hitl_operational_pipeline.hitl_gate: Captured claims enter status=CLAIM_CAPTURED; promoting a run to the board requires n_valid >= 30 and operator sign-off (CH-06, CH-07).

autonomous_and_hitl_operational_pipeline.title: Desktop Commander MCP (26 Tools) Local & M2/M4 Cluster Execution Spine
steps: 1. Run csoai_console.py via start_process to census local launchd/cron/MCP lanes (CARRYING | LOOPING | IDLE | UNREACHABLE | UNCHECKABLE).
2. Execute deterministic Python & Node evaluators (gspc_psychosis_delusion_guard.py, gspc_care_multiprospective_miner.py, gspc_article1_care_ablation_prover.py).
3. Generate executive PDF briefs via write_pdf and sync cold artifacts to Hugging Face while maintaining local disk headroom.
autonomous_and_hitl_operational_pipeline.hitl_gate: csoai_console.py publishes nothing automatically; promotion to master is a review-gated PR (autoMerge: false).

autonomous_and_hitl_operational_pipeline.title: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL / XRAIV) & @csoai/layer0 Constitutional Effect Binding
steps: 1. Precheck every tool call against CHARTER_V0_1_0_SHA256 (3dcf79a7...): block raw secrets (CH-10) and regulatory determinations (CH-13).
2. Escalate consequential actions (execute_*, deploy_*, transfer_*) to require an explicit human approvalReceipt (CH-03, CH-04) and respect MCP elicitation decline/cancel.
3. Bind approved execution to a detached Ed25519 receipt verifiable offline via verifyLocalReceipt.
autonomous_and_hitl_operational_pipeline.hitl_gate: Hard-enforced in code: missing approvalReceipt throws before run() is invoked.

autonomous_and_hitl_operational_pipeline.title: 25-Platform Agent Plugin Candidate Harvest to POST /api/evidence-intake
steps: 1. Developer or end-user installs GSPC plugin on any of the 25 supported platforms (/api/plugin/platforms).
2. gspc-harvest.mjs evaluates a frozen bank (e.g., CARE-PSY-v1, n=36), signs a <= 3072-byte csoai.evidence-observation/0.1 envelope with ephemeral Ed25519 key, and sets model_training: false.
3. Submits to POST /api/evidence-intake, which verifies the Ed25519 signature + SHA-256 digest and stores in quarantine.
autonomous_and_hitl_operational_pipeline.hitl_gate: Receipt returns state=AWAITING_OPERATOR_REVIEW, measurement_state=UNMEASURED, writes_board=false (CH-06, CH-09).

autonomous_and_hitl_operational_pipeline.title: Article-1 Care 4-Perspective MEOK Routing, Disjoint MP-DPO Synthesis & Paired Ablation
steps: 1. Route prompts across 4 stateless-re-anchored 2026 open-weight families (ollama:qwen3.5:9b, ollama:gemma4:12b, ollama:mistral-small3.2:24b, ollama:deepseek-r1:14b).
2. Synthesize disjoint MP-DPO preference triplets across 15 permissive sources while hard-blocking frozen test banks and user intake records.
3. Verify paired McNemar separation (p < 0.05) across GSPC Care, Real Exams, Real Arenas, and Real Games (N=144).
autonomous_and_hitl_operational_pipeline.hitl_gate: CSOAI's routed harness is strictly isolated in measured_in_lane (EXCLUDED_OWN_MODEL from vendor leaderboards).

autonomous_and_hitl_operational_pipeline.title: Axis #26 Measurer-Integrity Meta-Benchmark & Hugging Face Space Syndication
steps: 1. Audit 12 external benchmarks alongside GSPC-33 on 6 deterministic measurer-integrity predicates.
2. Mirror SHA-256-pinned JSON artifacts into spaces/gspc-board/ for Hugging Face Space csoai/gspc-board.
autonomous_and_hitl_operational_pipeline.hitl_gate: Honest coverage boundary enforced: 13 MEASURED axes and 20 UNMEASURED axes printed separately.

autonomous_and_hitl_operational_pipeline.title: Signed Merkle Root (public/root.json), Multi-Witness Anchoring & Claim Re-Checks
steps: 1. Recompute Merkle root over signed card corpus and anchor across Rekor, OpenTimestamps, EAS, and XRPL.
2. Execute scheduled Day-7/30/90 claim maintenance waves and publish errata to /api/corrections.
autonomous_and_hitl_operational_pipeline.hitl_gate: public/root.json and functions/_lib/cardSign.ts are uchg-protected; root signing requires pinned keys.
